intro.en: Three ways to work with pictures: ask a multimodal model about them, create them with an image model, or analyze them with Image Analysis.
intro.ro: Tasveeron ke saath kaam ke teen tareeqay: multimodal model se poochna, image model se banana, ya Image Analysis se jaiza.

text.en: One message holds a text part and one or more image parts.
text.ro: Ek message mein text part aur ek ya zyada image parts hote hain.

text.en: A public URL or a data URL: data:image/jpeg;base64,...
text.ro: Khula URL ya data URL: data:image/jpeg;base64,...

text.en: low: fewer tokens, less detail. high: small text readable, more tokens.
text.ro: low: kam tokens, kam tafseel. high: chhota text parha jata hai, zyada tokens.

text.en: images.generate(model, prompt, size, quality, n); gpt-image models return base64.
text.ro: images.generate(model, prompt, size, quality, n); gpt-image models base64 dete hain.

text.en: images.edit with an image and optional mask changes only part of it.
text.ro: images.edit image aur mask ke saath sirf ek hissa badalta hai.

text.en: analyze or analyze_from_url with visual_features such as CAPTION, TAGS, OBJECTS, PEOPLE, READ.
text.ro: analyze ya analyze_from_url, visual_features jaise CAPTION, TAGS, OBJECTS, PEOPLE, READ ke saath.

text.en: Prompts and images pass content filters; generated images carry content credentials.
text.ro: Prompts aur images content filters se guzarti hain; generated images mein content credentials hote hain.

text.en: Sora 2 creates videos from text, image or video as an asynchronous job: POST, poll the status, download.
text.ro: Sora 2 text, image ya video se asynchronous job ke taur par video banata hai: POST, status poochna, download.

title.en: Example: ask about a local photo
title.ro: Misaal: local tasveer ke baare mein sawal

text.en: The bytes are encoded as base64 and sent as a data URL next to the question.
text.ro: Bytes base64 mein encode ho kar sawal ke saath data URL ki soorat mein jati hain.

example.code:
image = base64.b64encode(open("sign.jpg", "rb").read()).decode()
r = openai.responses.create(model="vision-prod", input=[{
    "role": "user",
    "content": [
        {"type": "input_text", "text": "What does the sign say?"},
        {"type": "input_image", "image_url": f"data:image/jpeg;base64,{image}"},
    ]}])
print(r.output_text)

rows.en: Fixed tags, boxes and scores for millions of photos
rows.ro: Lakhon photos ke mukarrar tags, boxes aur scores
Text us ki jagah ke saath

remember.en: Chat Completions uses text and image_url parts; Responses uses input_text and input_image.
remember.ro: Chat Completions text aur image_url parts; Responses input_text aur input_image.

remember.en: The model cannot open a path on your computer.
remember.ro: Model aap ke computer ka path nahi khol sakta.

remember.en: Decode b64_json before you save the file.
remember.ro: File save karne se pehle b64_json decode karein.

remember.en: Only requested visual features are filled in the result.
remember.ro: Nateeje mein sirf maange gaye visual features hote hain.

traps.en: A vision model describes; an image model draws. The deployment must match.
traps.ro: Vision model bayan karta hai; image model banata hai. Deployment us ke mutabiq ho.

traps.en: A caption is one sentence; dense captions describe regions.
traps.ro: Caption ek jumla hai; dense captions hisse bayan karte hain.

traps.en: The answer to the POST request of a video job holds an id, not the video.
traps.ro: Video job ki POST request ke jawab mein id hoti hai, video nahi.
